notes: Transcribed from the International Studies Program's own major checklist (major code IS34). Every lower-division prerequisite, INTL core course and Disciplinary Focus course must be letter-graded C- or better. The language requirement and the one-region rule on the interdisciplinary electives are prose, not checkable here.

buckets.label: Accounting
buckets.note: Financial Accounting (MGT 4 or ECON 4) and MGT 5 Managerial Accounting.

buckets.label: International Studies Core
buckets.note: All three required. INTL 100 is a prerequisite for both INTL 101 and INTL 102, which are not sequential with each other.

buckets.label: Disciplinary Focus — Required
buckets.note: MGT 103, MGT 112, MGT 164 and MGT 166, plus either MGT 181 or MGT 187.

buckets.label: Disciplinary Focus — Electives
buckets.note: Three further four-unit upper-division courses from the pre-approved Disciplinary Focus list on the ISP website.

buckets.label: Interdisciplinary Electives and Regional Requirement
buckets.note: Three upper-division, four-unit, non-language courses outside management, all three focused on ONE region (Africa, East Asia, Europe, Latin America or the Middle East), from the pre-approved ISP list. Which courses count depends on the region you choose, so this is not checked here.

buckets.label: Language Requirement
buckets.note: Basic proficiency in a foreign language: the fourth quarter of a college-level language course, a proficiency exam, an AP/IB/SAT II language exam, or secondary education outside the United States.
